name: Country Loaf
shortDescription: Our everyday loaf — naturally leavened, blistered crust, open crumb.
description: A naturally leavened loaf built over two days. A long cold rise gives it a deep, mellow tang and an open, custardy crumb. Mixed, folded, and shaped by hand, baked dark for a crackling crust. Sold the morning it comes out of the oven.
